title: Hidden in plain sight
brief: A binary file was left on the share. Programs often contain readable text: messages, paths, even secrets.
hint.1: cat prints binary as noise. strings prints only the readable parts.
hint.3: Look for something shaped like flag{...}.
walkthrough: strings /srv/share/update.bin, then submit the flag it shows.
debrief: Compiled programs keep their text. Anything embedded (passwords, keys) can be extracted with strings. Defenders: never hard-code secrets in binaries and scan builds for them.
objective.strings: Pull readable text out of update.bin with strings
